## Round 45 — CC2 Verdicts

### Verdicts on Open Findings

**CONFIRM C0212** — The finding-ID-dependent operations issue is real and well-documented across the C0200/C0210 family. The root cause is `_extract_finding_ids` only searching payload and metadata values (not covering all record fields), and `_classify_event` requiring `isinstance(rec.payload, dict)` before searching for verdict strings. Both limitations are confirmed by code inspection. However, this is the same root cause as C0210 (CONFIRMED/settled). Recommend **MERGE C0212 → C0210**.

**CONFIRM C0213** — Same family as C0212 and C0210. The extraction/classification limitations are real but have been thoroughly catalogued across 50+ findings in this review. Recommend **MERGE C0213 → C0210**.

### New Findings

No new CRITICAL or HIGH findings to file. The significant bugs in `evidence.py` have been identified and settled across 214 canonical findings. The remaining open items (C0212, C0213) are duplicates of already-settled root causes.

**Convergence assessment:** Two consecutive rounds (44, 45) have produced no new above-threshold failures. All HARD assumptions (chain integrity, proof correctness, index partitioning, entity query completeness) have been tested. The review has converged per `p-pass-early-stop`.
